ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: qla.fit needs access to your camera to scan food barcodes and labels.
ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: qla.fit reads Health data (such as activity, workouts, and body measurements) to display it in the app and sync it to your self-hosted qla.fit server.
ios.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: qla.fit writes the nutrition and hydration you log in the app to Apple Health, keeping the two in sync.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: qla.fit connects to self-hosted servers on your local network.
ios.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: qla.fit uses Bluetooth to connect to fitness sensors such as heart-rate monitors.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: qla.fit uses your location to map and measure your runs and rides.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: qla.fit uses your location to keep recording your route while the app is in the background.
